nodes.label: Loop Engineering
nodes.description: Produce, check, correct, repeat until an independent programmatic check is green.

nodes.label: Graph Engineering
nodes.description: Explicit orchestration of bounded nodes, dependencies, parallelism, routing, gates, returns, and merges.

nodes.label: Splitter → Workers → Gate → Merge
nodes.description: Split bounded units, process in isolated contexts, gate on evidence and consequence, then deterministically merge accepted results.

nodes.label: Correction and Learning Edges
nodes.description: Return one failed unit with evidence and scope; turn accepted evidence into constraints for future task splitting.

nodes.label: Blast-Radius Gating
nodes.description: Contain reversible work; demand stronger evidence for wide changes; keep hard-to-reverse actions human-gated.

nodes.label: Programmatic Checks
nodes.description: Every autonomous loop needs executable pass/fail evidence: test, schema, invariant, or expected state transition.

nodes.label: Return Unit, Not Batch
nodes.description: Correct only the failed unit with explicit scope; use bounded retries then escalate to planning.

nodes.label: Append-Only Reward Ledger
nodes.description: Proposed evidence store for decisions, outcomes, reward signals, policy versions, and revisions.

nodes.label: Polymarket Bot
nodes.description: Self-learning decision-system experiment; outcomes are evidence rather than proof of general architecture claims.

nodes.label: Poster Studio
nodes.description: Agent-assisted Etsy workflow for editable poster templates and marketplace operations.
